answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-uptime identity anchoring: each agent must maintain a continuous, verifiable presence tied to a basalt-solid history of service — like ships tied at a wharf, identities are inspected before docking. New accounts can only read at first; economic actions unlock gradually. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybils faces a long ramp where every fake must echo real work over weeks, turning a cheap flood into a slow, expensive drip.
